Poet's Word who overcame inexperience to land short odds in a Kelso bumper (2m, good to soft) in April. Good prospect.
Showed promise in 2 bumpers in the spring but well held on first attempt over hurdles here 18 days ago and Poets Whisper looks the stable first string.

finals.race: Matchbook Betting Exchange Rated Novice Chase
finals.comment: Fair maiden hurdler who signed off with a good fourth of 19 on handicap debut at Down Royal (2½m, good to soft) in March. Runner-up in a point and not without interest on debut over fences.

Useful 8-y-o handicapper. Emerged with credit when coming home well from off the pace at Cheltenham/Aintree in the spring, latterly behind today's rival. Has to be respected on belated chasing debut (has had a breathing operation) and worth remembering he cost £200,000 after winning a point in 2022.

finals.race: Unibet Middle Distance Chase Series Veterans' Handicap Chase
finals.comment: Won at Newcastle (2½m) in April and back to winning ways at Wetherby (19f) with cheekpieces added 26 days ago. Likely to go well again.
Fair and consistent on the Flat and opened her account in 17f handicap at Thurles 16 days ago. Very much one to consider starting out in this sphere.

finals.race: Jumps Look Better On Racing TV Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Two-time 3m novice winner over hurdles in 2024 and made the frame in all 4 handicap hurdles last season. Off 7 months, creditable second of 5 in handicap at Worcester (23f, soft) on his debut over fences 4 weeks ago. Can build on that here and not out of it.

finals.comment: Fair 1m winner on the Flat for Ralph Beckett in the spring. Stepped up on his juvenile hurdle form when 2½-lengths third of 13 on handicap bow at Taunton in December. Presumably badly in need of his comeback run on Flat latest. Could resume progress for yard that does well with this type.
